title: Leaving the program via a Don't Ask Don't Tell letter

tellings.quote: admitted I said I wrote a letter to my commander

plain: In the early 1990s, a former Air Force sergeant named Dan Sherman says he got out of a secret programme by writing a letter to his commander under Don't Ask, Don't Tell, the US military's policy on gay service members. Sherman, who says the NSA, the US eavesdropping agency, hired him to communicate with aliens, tells Michels it happened at a site he calls Base 2. The story explains how, by his account, he managed to leave a programme that was otherwise hard to walk away from.
